x: Then, on September 10th, Mark became the first Belgravian to hold all Club Records for an event, from Boys' age group to Seniors', when he cleared 4.20m in an invitation event at Woking won by Britis[illegible] Record holder Brian Hooper.

Ian Tullett from our club and Brian Hooper succeeded in clearing the 4.03m wall grabbing at three bottles each, whilst Andy Ashurst (Sale Harriers) and Mark Johnson (Haringey) managed to bring the wall down to the delight of the audience.
Elsewhere we were treated to a 54.78m hammer throw by BBC commentator Paul Dickenson, a 4.30m pole vault by Brian Hooper, and an 11.6/23.5 sprint double by Alastair Ross.
